title: 5 Marathi Gratitude Stories(Part 1)
subtitle: Beautiful Marathi moral stories for kids
description: Give your child the gift of good values with this beautiful collection of 5 short gratitude stories in Marathi. Each story is crafted to teach children the importance of being thankful and content. Perfect for bedtime reading and early moral development. Includes engaging illustrations to keep kids interested. (Part 1 of the Gratitude Series)

title: Circle the Color Workbook (14 Pages)
subtitle: Fun color recognition workbook in English, Hindi & Marathi
description: Make learning colors exciting with this 14-page interactive workbook! Covering 14 vibrant colors—from basics like Red, Blue, and Yellow to shades like Teal, Lavender, and Turquoise. It is perfect for preschoolers and early learners to build color recognition, visual focus, and trilingual vocabulary.

title: Brain Booster & Logical Reasoning Workbook (16 Pages)
subtitle: Trending screen-free pattern, shadow matching, odd one out & counting workboo
description: Boost your child's logical thinking and visual focus with this 16-page Brain Booster Workbook! Packed with 4 trending preschool activities including Complete the Pattern, Odd One Out, Shadow Matching, and Count & Circle. Designed with clear instructions in English, Hindi, and Marathi, it is ideal for ages 3 to 6 (Nursery, LKG, UKG) for screen-free daily brain practice.

title: Pre-Writing Pencil Control & Tracing Workbook (12 Pages)
subtitle: Line tracing & shape tracing practice for Playgroup and Nursery kids
description: Build strong fine motor skills and pencil grip with this 12-page Pre-Writing Tracing Workbook! Covers standing lines, sleeping lines, slanting lines, zig-zags, waves, castle steps, curves, and 8 big traceable shapes. Comes with simple instructions in English, Hindi, and Marathi, making it perfect for ages 2.5 to 5 before starting alphabet and number writing.

title: Fun Mazes & Picture Sudoku Workbook (12 Pages)
subtitle: Progressive brain-teasing mazes & 4x4 shape sudoku puzzles for kids
description: Sharpen problem-solving skills and concentration with this 12-page Fun Mazes & Picture Sudoku Workbook! Includes 6 progressive path-finding mazes from easy 5x5 grids to super-star 10x10 challenges, plus 6 engaging 4x4 Picture Sudoku puzzles using colorful shapes. Features trilingual instructions in English, Hindi, and Marathi for ages 4 to 7 (LKG, UKG, Grade 1).
